ownerDirection: A void space with a central presence reminiscent of a supermassive black hole; push the experience much further into the trippy rather than grounding every image in the existing relationship plot.
visualDirection: Third-person Blaise on a discontinuous strip of theatre floor inside an enormous void.
A black centre, warped luminous ring and asymmetrically folded light dominate the entire environment.
Recognizable rooms and actions pass through the ring at impossible scales, with no reliable common horizon.
Camera orientation and the relationship between body, viewpoint and world become unstable; provide a reduced-motion presentation.
The player's moving Blaise and stationary prior-looking figures separate; the scene ends with a figure performing a gesture Blaise has not made.
openStoryQuestions: Where the encounter belongs in the shared narrative and what causes entry/exit.
Whether the visible figures are appearances, remembered events or independently acting persons; this draft does not settle that.
What later evidence challenges the interpretations Blaise forms here.
How the final unfamiliar gesture develops into an actual revelation without introducing an arbitrary mechanism.
philosophicalScope: Investigates the conditions of an experienced world, objective sequence, an observer outside all appearances, and the relationship of particular existence to immanent substance. It does not establish access to noumena, treat a black hole as God, prove literal time reversal, or collapse individual people into interchangeable pieces of one collection.
researchStatus: Read the current exact Mercy voice anchors and primary-source scene map. No new astrophysics research or simulation is claimed; the object is a fictional visual resemblance.
reviewStatus: Root exploratory draft only. No lead-writer approval or owner acceptance claimed. Existing seven canon modules, live selected content and both released packages are untouched.
